World: terracotta mesas, warm ivory sand, muted turquoise glass crystals, petrified mauve wood, violet night shade. Recurring mobile home is a compact wooden four-wheel caravan with SKY-BLUE ARCHED ROOF, cream cabin, COPPER wheels, AMBER fabric awning. Friendly animal community. No coast, islands, boats, post office, mail delivery, spa or hot springs. No ordinary large crop farm.
UI invariant: thin dark-plum pixel panels with cream pixel lettering, small day/time/weather panel top left, small 3-row objective/evidence panel upper right, eight-slot tool/item hotbar bottom center, minimal clock/map icon. UI must not cover the main playable area or focal action. A tiny warm-gold selection outline connects player to active target. Short English labels only, large and readable; no paragraphs or Korean glyph approximation. HUD is visually illustrative rather than final text. No marketing title or watermark. Keep walkable space and action easy to read.

scenes.title: 아침의 도감차
scenes.scene: Morning in a desert caravan camp with 3 compact resident wagons around a communal shade sail. The player's consistent blue-roof cream wagon occupies upper left, its open doorway showing a tiny bed and books. Corgi stands at a foldout route map and tool table beside the wagon. Two small planter boxes with distinctive desert foliage, a kettle, folding stool, and packed observation camera feel lived-in. Forked stone footpaths lead visibly toward a distant petrified grove and sandstone canyon exits. Three friendly animal residents are small NPC sprites, not a crowd. This is about choosing today's outing and preparing a mobile home. HUD exact short labels: 'DAY 04', '07:00', 'CAMP', 'PACK & PLAN'; hotbar shows notebook, lens, water flask, brush, mirror, seed pouch, snack and empty slot.

scenes.title: 규화목 숲의 흔적
scenes.scene: Playable petrified forest room: fallen lavender fossil trunks create branching paths in pale sand, long stone root bridges, turquoise glass stones. Corgi is crouching beside three clear animal pawprints and a gnawed seed shell on the left path. Ahead a tiny glass-backed beetle emerges from under a wide stone beside a host plant; a nonthreatening distant animal is visible. A dotted investigation boundary circles only the clue, not a navigation trail. An already visited path and an unexplored side hollow are both readable, with an open return path bottom. UI evidence card contains three little icons (track, seed, beetle) with two checked boxes and one empty. Labels: 'GROVE', '10:20', 'TRACKS 2/3', 'OBSERVE'. Main action is observation and matching habitat evidence, not collecting piles of loot.

scenes.title: 그늘 협곡의 빛 퍼즐
scenes.scene: A compact orthographic topdown sandstone canyon puzzle room with two elevations separated by a wide safe stair and warm terracotta walls. Corgi stands beside a rotatable brass reflector; ONE clear soft cyan light beam is aimed at a carved glass disk on a shaded wall. A second reflector, two orientation marks, and an unopened shaded side chamber make the puzzle legible. Sunlit hot stones use hatching and shade uses clear flat colors. Crucially a permanent long safe stone walkway with steps along the side connects back to camp; no deadly gap or mandatory timed jump. Player chooses rotate reflector to reveal a fossil rubbing niche or take the longer route. Minimal labels 'CANYON', '14:00', 'TURN MIRROR', 'SIDE ROOM'. Avoid laser combat. Amber/cream/violet colors, path readability first.

scenes.title: 유리사구의 밤 관찰
scenes.scene: Nighttime orthographic topdown glass dunes, broad walkable lavender sand terraces with modest luminous turquoise crystal outcrops and sparse white night-bloom flowers. Corgi has placed a small shaded observation stool beside a pale flowering cactus. A clearly visible cluster of THREE luminous moth sprites hovers in a small triangle between flower, crystal shadow and dew patch. Player is observing a moth feeding on an open flower, with a warm-gold selection outline around that specific flower. Small safe camp lantern at bottom edge, clear return footpath, star-speckled dark sky only as tiny distant upper backdrop, mostly playable ground. Evidence panel three icons for NIGHT, BLOOM, CALM; labels 'DUNES', '21:00', 'BEHAVIOR FOUND'. Beautiful restrained night contrast, no dramatic poster framing.

scenes.title: 차 안의 작은 서식 정원
scenes.scene: Orthographic topdown cutaway INTERIOR of the consistent compact mobile home wagon, walls removed toward viewer in classic tile-based game interior. Cozy rectangular cabin with narrow bed, books, kettle, desk, window and ample walkable central aisle. scenes.title: 묻힌 화석정원의 깊은 탐험
scenes.scene: A late-exploration subterranean fossil sinkhole room, orthographic topdown tile-based 2D pixel art. Teal glass veins in mauve limestone, giant fern fossil imprints in wall and floor, broken but walkable layered terraces. Corgi kneels at a selected spiral fossil slab making a PAPER RUBBING using a brush, with small paper and completed imprint icon. A gentle reflected beam from a small placed prism illuminates an overlooked side niche; footprints lead to a second unexplored route. To right a clearly OPEN WOODEN LADDER and labeled return marker go up to sunlight, demonstrating an unlocked permanent shortcut. No monsters/combat, no bottomless unsafe jumps, no observatory restoration, no technological ruin machinery. UI labels 'FOSSIL GARDEN', 'RUBBING FOUND', 'RETURN OPEN'. Contrast the turquoise light, dusty amber fossil and purple rock, show concrete collection and path choice rather than just scenery.
